provenance.encodes: Bluebook R. 14.3 and T1.2 (SEC no-action letters) (21st ed.)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open Bluebook T1.2 (SEC) for the no-action letter form `Name, SEC No-Action Letter (date)`.

positive.text: See Apple Inc., SEC No-Action Letter (Jan. 5, 2023).
Staff confirmed the view in Walmart Inc., SEC No-Action Letter, 2021 WL 123456 (Mar. 1, 2021).
Cf. Exxon Mobil Corp., SEC No-Action Letter (March 20, 2019).

negative: The SEC took no action on the letter.
A no-action letter is staff guidance, not law.
The company sent the SEC a letter on Jan. 5, 2023.

note: The requester's name before the comma is not part of the span; there is no stable identifier, so no authority_key.
